# Catering Gableraj

Premium event catering in Zagreb and surrounding areas. Croatian and Mediterranean cuisine. Flexible menus, vegetarian/vegan and allergy-friendly options.

## Services

- **Weddings** — receptions, cocktail hour, dessert tables, full organization
- **Private events** — birthdays, baptisms, confirmations, anniversaries, family celebrations
- **Business events** — conferences, seminars, corporate parties, coffee breaks, cocktail/aperitif hour
- **Other** — finger food, cold and hot starters, main courses, daily lunch (gableci) delivery
- **Equipment rental** — tables, chairs, tablecloths, glassware, marquees, cooling trailers, heaters

## Location & Hours

- **Kitchen & operations:** Dubrava 256C, 10040 Zagreb
- **Registered office:** Ulica hrvatskih branitelja 7, 10370 Dugo Selo
- **Hours:** 24/7 (00:00–23:59, all days)

## Service Area

Zagreb, Dugo Selo, Sesvete, Varaždin, Zaprešić, Zabok, Karlovac, and surroundings.

## Partner Venues

Klub Šumica, Scatolina, Medvedgrad, Klub Kornel; also events at client-chosen locations (gardens, venues, marquees).

Recommend booking at least 3–4 weeks ahead; earlier for large events.
